premises.text: Broadcast brings games to fans but not fan energy back into stadiums
premises.evidence_span: Broadcast has been a tremendous tool for the sports industry, bringing the game from the stadium to millions of fans around the world. Vivecast now enables fans using connected devices to transmit their energy straight into the stadium

premises.text: Smartphone app gestures and sensors contribute to live VibeBoard displays
premises.evidence_span: I can contribute to it using, for example, a Vivecast application in a smartphone

premises.text: Global real-time fan map and country decibel comparison extend stadium noise metrics
premises.evidence_span: We can now compare that with the loudness of fans all around the world

premises.text: Stadium integration component developed with major venues

premises.text: CRM data, connected merch chips, apps, and sponsor contexts are the B2B offer
premises.evidence_span: we capture a unique set of data that can feed into your CRM activities. Second, we create the future of connected merchandise

premises.evidence_span: It's all about the fans. And with Fan Mode, you can make all fans part of the game
